# What the runner reports for each terminal outcome of a claimed run
# (refactor plan step S15a; OpenV REQ-84). Written by TestRunFailureClassesGolden
# in internal/runner, which has the real Worker.Run claim every scenario from a
# stand-in API and records, per run, the requests it sent (log pushes left out),
# each finish or release body byte for byte, and the error class that reached
# the API with whether the platform retries it (agentruns.IsRetryableClass).
# Requests go as the worker key unless marked "(as <credential>)"; "adapter
# called with env" is the environment the worker handed the provider adapter,
# and "adapter called with spec" the rest of what it handed it: answer_rule
# says the system prompt is the agent's own followed by agentruns'
# AnswerLengthRule, and mcp_env=env that the MCP server gets that environment.
# Not covered: a cancel noticed during workspace preparation, which the
# 30-second preparation heartbeat (prepHeartbeatInterval) reports. A refactor
# leaves this file byte-identical; a deliberate change regenerates it with
#   UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./internal/mcp ./internal/runner -run TestRunFailureClassesGolden

## no-adapter
given: the agent's provider, gemini-cli, has no adapter on this runner
POST /api/v1/agent-runs/no-adapter/finish {"status":"failed","final_text":"","error":"no adapter for provider gemini-cli","error_class":"provider_unavailable","tokens_in":0,"tokens_out":0}
class: provider_unavailable (retried)

## no-adapter-blank-provider
given: the agent names no provider
POST /api/v1/agent-runs/no-adapter-blank-provider/finish {"status":"failed","final_text":"","error":"no adapter for provider ","error_class":"provider_unavailable","tokens_in":0,"tokens_out":0}
class: provider_unavailable (retried)

## no-tools
given: the agent's allowed_tools is empty
POST /api/v1/agent-runs/no-tools/finish {"status":"failed","final_text":"","error":"agent Field Agent (field-agent) names no tools it may use: agent definition requires allowed_tools: every agent must name the tools its vendor CLI may use (e.g. mcp__openv__*), because a CLI started with no allowlist runs with all of them","error_class":"agent_error","tokens_in":0,"tokens_out":0}
class: agent_error (not retried)

## no-tools-blank-entries
given: the agent's allowed_tools holds only blanks, and the agent has a slug and no name
POST /api/v1/agent-runs/no-tools-blank-entries/finish {"status":"failed","final_text":"","error":"agent field-agent names no tools it may use: agent definition requires allowed_tools: every agent must name the tools its vendor CLI may use (e.g. mcp__openv__*), because a CLI started with no allowlist runs with all of them","error_class":"agent_error","tokens_in":0,"tokens_out":0}
class: agent_error (not retried)

## no-tools-unnamed
given: the agent's allowed_tools is null, and the agent has neither name nor slug
POST /api/v1/agent-runs/no-tools-unnamed/finish {"status":"failed","final_text":"","error":"agent (unnamed) names no tools it may use: agent definition requires allowed_tools: every agent must name the tools its vendor CLI may use (e.g. mcp__openv__*), because a CLI started with no allowlist runs with all of them","error_class":"agent_error","tokens_in":0,"tokens_out":0}
class: agent_error (not retried)

## repo-access-unsupported
given: a codex-cli agent with repository access
POST /api/v1/agent-runs/repo-access-unsupported/finish {"status":"failed","final_text":"","error":"agent Field Agent (field-agent): repository access requires the claude-code provider: codex-cli cannot confine edits per tool; use claude-code or turn repo access off","error_class":"agent_error","tokens_in":0,"tokens_out":0}
class: agent_error (not retried)

## null-agent
given: the claim's agent is null (the worker panics reading it)
POST /api/v1/agent-runs/null-agent/finish {"status":"failed","final_text":"","error":"worker panic during run execution","error_class":"worker_error","tokens_in":0,"tokens_out":0}
class: worker_error (retried)

## workspace-prep-fails
given: a file stands where the run's workspace directory goes
POST /api/v1/agent-runs/workspace-prep-fails/finish {"status":"failed","final_text":"","error":"workspace preparation failed: mkdir <workspaces>/workspace-prep-fails: not a directory","error_class":"workspace","tokens_in":0,"tokens_out":0}
class: workspace (not retried)

## repo-connections-unreadable
given: a claude-code agent with repository access whose project's connections answer 403
GET /api/v1/projects/p-repo-connections-unreadable/repo-connections (as rt-repo-connections-unreadable)
POST /api/v1/agent-runs/repo-connections-unreadable/finish {"status":"failed","final_text":"","error":"could not read the project's repository connections: api returned 403: {\"error\":\"forbidden\",\"code\":\"forbidden\"}","error_class":"workspace","tokens_in":0,"tokens_out":0}
class: workspace (not retried)

## start-transition-refused
given: the API answers the start transition 409
POST /api/v1/agent-runs/start-transition-refused/start
POST /api/v1/agent-runs/start-transition-refused/finish {"status":"failed","final_text":"","error":"start transition failed: api returned 409: {\"error\":\"run is not claimed by this worker\",\"code\":\"conflict\"}","error_class":"worker_error","tokens_in":0,"tokens_out":0}
class: worker_error (retried)

## api-key-variable-not-allowed
given: api-key auth naming WORKER_API_KEY, which is not a provider key variable
POST /api/v1/agent-runs/api-key-variable-not-allowed/start
POST /api/v1/agent-runs/api-key-variable-not-allowed/finish {"status":"failed","final_text":"","error":"this project's provider setting names WORKER_API_KEY as its API key variable, which is not a provider key variable; fix the provider setting in workspace settings","error_class":"auth","tokens_in":0,"tokens_out":0}
class: auth (not retried)

## api-key-missing
given: api-key auth with the provider's default variable, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, unset on the runner host
POST /api/v1/agent-runs/api-key-missing/start
POST /api/v1/agent-runs/api-key-missing/finish {"status":"failed","final_text":"","error":"this project uses API-key auth, but ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set on the runner host — set it (or switch the project back to user-account auth)","error_class":"auth","tokens_in":0,"tokens_out":0}
class: auth (not retried)

## api-key-present
given: a codex-cli agent on api-key auth naming GEMINI_API_KEY, which is set on the runner host
adapter called with env: OPENAI_API_KEY=gemini-key-from-the-runner-host OPENV_API_URL=https://openv.example OPENV_RUN_TOKEN=rt-api-key-present
adapter called with spec: workdir=<workspaces>/api-key-present prompt="Summarise the open risks." system_prompt="Be precise." answer_rule=true model="model-x" effort="high" mcp=/opt/openv/bin/openv-mcp mcp_env=env allowed_tools=["mcp__openv__*","Read"] untrusted=false repo_access=false max_turns=50 timeout=600
POST /api/v1/agent-runs/api-key-present/start
POST /api/v1/agent-runs/api-key-present/finish {"status":"succeeded","exit_code":0,"final_text":"Done.","error":"","tokens_in":0,"tokens_out":0}
class: none
